comment: Decision 4 bake-off corpus: 6 RP scenarios, 60 memories, 30 queries. Queries deliberately paraphrase (little verbatim overlap) so the score reflects semantic recall, not string matching. Relevance = the memory a character would need to answer in-scene. Swap in real chat/lore dumps any time; same shape.

memories.text: Mira slipped the stolen amulet under the loose floorboard behind the bar before the guards arrived.
A hooded courier left a wax-sealed letter for Vardus; the seal bore a two-headed crow.
The cellar smells of vinegar and old oak; one barrel marked with white chalk is always kept locked.
Vardus pays the town guard captain every new moon to ignore the gambling den upstairs.
Seamus broke his wrist in the brawl last autumn and still can't lift a full keg with his left hand.
The password at the back door changed to 'ember and ash' after the smugglers were betrayed.
Mira hates the smell of lavender; her sister wore it the night she disappeared.
A ranger paid for his room with a strange coin stamped with a spiral — Vardus kept it in the lockbox.
The bard Elowen only performs the ballad of the drowned king when someone she distrusts is in the room, as a signal.
There is a crawlspace from the pantry to the stable loft, wide enough for a child or a halfling.
Engineer Okafor rerouted coolant through deck seven after the primary loop micro-fractured.
The station AI, CASSIA, loses forty milliseconds of memory every time the ion storm peaks.
Captain Reyes keeps a pre-collapse Earth photograph taped inside her locker: a pier at sunset.
Airlock C-3 has a faulty pressure sensor; it reads green even when the seal is compromised.
The stowaway hides in hydroponics bay two, living off the tomato crop and recycled water.
Dr. Lin's clearance was quietly revoked after she copied the medical records of the colony ship survivors.
A distress beacon from the mining rig Prometheus repeats the same four words: 'do not dock here'.
Okafor and Reyes served together on the Meridian; neither talks about why it was decommissioned.
The black-market dealer on ring four trades antibiotics for navigation charts of the outer belt.
CASSIA has started referring to the crew in past tense during routine announcements.
The matchbook from the Blue Orchid club had a phone number written inside in violet ink.
Detective Harlan's partner was on the Delgado family payroll for six years before the harbor incident.
The widow Castellane lied about the night of the fire; her car was seen across town at the rail yard.
A pawnshop on Verity Street fences jewelry for the eastside crews; the owner owes Harlan a favor.
The coroner found river silt in the victim's lungs, but the body was discovered in a hotel bathtub.
Singer Lena Moreau wears a key on a chain; it opens a deposit box at First Meridian Bank.
Harlan quit drinking the day his daughter stopped answering his calls; he still orders soda water at bars to listen.
The Delgado accountant keeps a second ledger bound in green leather, never taken out of the club.
A beat cop named Wojcik radioed in sick the night of the warehouse fire — the third such coincidence.
The city councilman's campaign was financed through a laundry on Hale Avenue.
The stone door on level two opens only when the braziers are lit in the order: wolf, serpent, crown.
Kael the paladin carries his dead brother's sword; it hums near undead.
The goblin matron Gribna sold the party a map that omits the flooded passage on purpose.
Thessaly's familiar, a moth the size of a hand, can scout ahead but dies in strong drafts.
The party owes the Ashen Covenant three favors for the resurrection of the rogue, Pip.
Rust monsters nest in the armory level; steel weapons must be left behind or wrapped in wax cloth.
Pip pocketed the obsidian idol from the shrine despite the warning glyphs; it whispers at night.
The underground river exits through a grate behind the waterfall, two hours' walk from the entrance.
Kael is afraid of deep water and has never told the others; he nearly drowned as a squire.
The lich's phylactery is not in the crypt: the oracle said it travels with 'the one who mourns him'.
June keeps the movie ticket stub from their first date pressed in her copy of 'Letters to a Young Poet'.
Theo burned the risotto the night he planned to propose and ordered dumplings instead; the ring stayed in his coat.
June's mother disapproves of Theo because he reminds her of June's father, who left.
The bakery on Crescent Lane sells out of cardamom buns by nine; Theo bikes there early on June's bad days.
June was offered the research fellowship in Copenhagen; she hasn't told Theo it starts in January.
Theo's grandmother's garden had a crooked apple tree; he wants to plant one wherever they settle.
They argue in grocery stores, never at home — something about neutral ground makes it safe.
June plays piano only when she thinks no one is listening; Theo records it through the wall sometimes.
The lighthouse keeper's log ends mid-sentence on March 9th: 'the light turned inward and I saw'.
Professor Ashcroft's translation of the basalt tablet took his sight but he keeps correcting it in braille.
The town of Grey Hollow holds a 'quiet festival' each equinox; no one speaks from dusk to dawn.
Marina's reflection lags half a second behind her since the night dive at the drowned church.
The antique dealer bought back the music box at triple the price, begging them never to wind it fully.
Every photograph of the Hollow Point cliffs shows one more figure than was present.
Father Okonkwo lines his church windowsills with salt and iron filings and calls it 'tradition'.
The thing in the well answers questions truthfully but each answer costs the asker a memory of someone they love.
Marina's dive partner surfaced forty minutes after she did, insisting he'd been down for two.
The county map from 1901 shows a second town, Black Hollow, where the reservoir is now.

Is there a way to sneak from the kitchen storage to the stables unseen?
What does it mean when Elowen starts singing that song about the sunken monarch?
What was in the sealed message delivered to the innkeeper?
Why is the cooling system running through the seventh deck now?
Which airlock should we avoid trusting the status lights on?
Where is the person who snuck aboard getting food?
What's wrong with the station computer lately? It sounds off.
What did that automated SOS from the mining platform keep saying?
Why did the doctor lose her access badge?
What's the history between the captain and the engineer?
What did the autopsy say about how he actually drowned?
Who can move stolen rings and bracelets for the east side gangs?
What does the key around the singer's neck unlock?
Where does the mob keep their real books?
Was my old partner dirty?
How is the councilman's money getting cleaned?
What's the correct sequence for lighting the fire bowls at the sealed door?
Why shouldn't we bring our metal gear into the lower level?
Can we trust the map the goblin woman gave us?
What do we still owe the cult that brought Pip back?
Where is the lich keeping his soul vessel?
Why won't Kael cross the underground lake?
What is June hiding about the job offer abroad?
Why does Theo get up before dawn to cycle across town some mornings?
What happened the evening he meant to ask her to marry him?
What's strange about Marina's mirror image since the wreck dive?
What price does the creature at the bottom of the well demand?
What used to exist where the lake is today?
